_comment: WHAT is generated: big patches of Eisblock that replace grass and dirt near the surface.
>>> To use another block from our mod, change 'Name' below. <<<
'target' = which blocks get replaced. #minecraft:dirt includes grass blocks, dirt, podzol, etc.
Use minecraft:base_stone_overworld instead to replace stone.
How often / at which height it appears is set in worldgen/placed_feature/eis_patch.json.
